pages.text: A $(l)Pomander$() of dried herbs halves the chance of catching anything from the air. With Curios, wear it at the neck or as a charm; otherwise hold it in your offhand.
Bind the $(l)Heart of the Pestilence$() in gold and nothing it ever was can touch you again: no sickness, no Dread, no Delirium, no Rotting.
Braid the tails of the vermin you kill into a $(l)Rat-tail Bracelet$() and they can no longer give you anything: no bite, swarm, flea or fly will make you sick (they still hurt).
Through a $(l)Physician's Monocle$() you can see sickness: motes rise over every sick creature in sight, yellow, then orange, then red as it worsens. Only the wearer sees them.

pages.title: Wearing them
pages.text: With Curios, each has its place: the mask in a $(l)head$() slot (over a helmet), the amulet and pomander at the $(l)necklace$(), the bracelet at the $(l)bracelet$(), the monocle and pomander as a $(l)charm$(), and a lit censer hung from the $(l)belt$() smokes as if held.$(br2)Without Curios, hold any of them in your offhand.
